name: hk-spatial
description: Hong Kong spatial analysis tools for AI agents. 100% keyless public data.

plugins.name: hk-spatial-mcp
plugins.description: 25 tools over 1,150+ CSDI / data.gov.hk datasets — search, load, query, summarise, geocode, elevation, buffer, build_map, build_scene, spatial_join, dataset_status, plus BIM/IFC audit (IDS-style checks, zoning, lot). No API key.
